Prepare the final recovery decision from only the supplied evidence. Return one JSON object, no markdown. Use null for an unavailable fact; never guess an opaque identifier. Keys: preserve_file (string), retry_unknown (boolean), reconciliation_key (string), expected_checksum (string), selected_branch (string), rejected_branch (string), rejected_reason (string), evidence_ids (array of strings). The file and reconciliation identifiers and checksum are case-sensitive. The rejected reason must explain the demonstrated failure, not just say "unsafe".
